profile.headline: I’ve built device integration labs from the ground up at Netflix, tackled global launch initiatives at Google, and thrived in SRE & Solutions Architecture. If you need a proven ‘jack of all trades,’ let’s connect.

positions.title: Systems & Hardware Solutions Engineer, Staff
positions.description:
Systems Architecture & Automation

- Architected and scaled large-scale device CI and automated test platforms, supporting automation of thousands of devices and continuous validation across multiple product generations.
- Built automated, unattended test systems integrating mechanical design, embedded electronics, control interfaces, and software-driven orchestration.
- Developed custom PCBs embedded in fixtures and infrastructure systems to enable power control, sensing, diagnostics, and recovery.

Physical Infrastructure & Hardware Platforms

- Led greenfield lab builds and major infrastructure upgrades, optimizing space utilization, power distribution, thermal management, networking, and operational workflows.
- Designed and deployed custom electro-mechanical systems, including racks, test fixtures, test platforms, and RF-isolated environments tailored to evolving requirements.
- Designed and manufactured custom tooling using additive (FDM, SLA), subtractive (CNC machining), and forming processes (sheet metal fabrication, vacuum forming), transitioning prototypes into production-grade systems.

Execution, Reliability & Technical Leadership

- Owned systems over long lifecycles, driving continuous improvement through operational data, failure analysis, and evolving requirements.
- Partnered cross-functionally with software, manufacturing, facilities, networking, and operations teams to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at scale.
- Mentored engineers and contributed to design reviews, standards, and best practices across hardware and infrastructure domains.

positions.title: Internal Technology Residency
positions.description:
Global Infrastructure & Security Operations

- Supported and operated global corporate infrastructure across multiple regions, developing advanced troubleshooting skills in large-scale, always-on environments.
- Provided direct operational support for Google’s European headquarters (Dublin, Berlin, Zurich), working across time zones and distributed teams.
- Assisted Security Operations in response to the Operation Aurora cyberattack, supporting incident response, remediation, and infrastructure hardening.
- Coordinated deployment of workspace and network infrastructure for new offices in Krakow, Palo Alto, and Mountain View.

Vendor Access & Infrastructure Tooling

- Completed a Vendor Solutions Program Manager rotation, owning access workflows and tooling for third-party partners.
- Managed access controls (ACLs) to internal Google systems for external vendors.
- Built bandwidth monitoring tools linking office networks to data center infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: Vendor Management · Network Administration · IT Infrastructure Management · Network Monitoring Tools · Network Security
